name: Malik Kafur
contribution: A prominent general of the Delhi Sultanate ruler Alauddin Khalji.
legacy: As a commander of Alauddin's forces, this person defeated the Mongol invaders in 1306.

checks.lead: Malik Kafur (died c. 11 February 1316), also known as Taj al-Din Izz al-Dawla, was a prominent general of the Delhi Sultanate ruler Alauddin Khalji. He was captured by Alauddin's general Nusrat Khan during the 1299 invasion of Gujarat, and rose to prominence around 1305.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
